name: seo
title: SEO & AI Discoverability
summary: End-to-end SEO engineering: crawlability/indexability, on-page relevance, schema.org structured data, Core Web Vitals, internationalization — plus AI/LLM discoverability (llms.txt, GEO, E-E-A-T) for AI Overviews and answer engines.
mandatory_tests: Rich Results / structured-data validation passes for each templated page type
robots.txt is valid and does not block CSS/JS; an XML sitemap exists and is referenced
Core Web Vitals within thresholds on key templates (LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1)
validations: Every indexable page has a unique title and meta description
Exactly one self-referential canonical per page; no conflicting canonicals
No stray noindex on pages meant to rank
Primary content is present in the server-rendered HTML (not JS-only)
JSON-LD is valid and matches the visible content
hreflang is reciprocal and valid for every locale (with x-default)
llms.txt present and an explicit AI-crawler policy is set
